rules: ChatGPT/System Architect owns production visual truth.
Claude must consume asset IDs and atlas metadata; do not hard-code source sheet coordinates.
Do not recolor/crop/redraw approved R3 assets without a new visual revision.
Avatar is rendered as a circular masked layer at per-asset headSocket for dancer bodies.
Runtime prefers WebP atlases; individual PNG/WebP files are source/fallback package.
R3 atlases include transparent padding to prevent cross-frame texture sampling bleed.
VIP male sprites contain no baked facial identity; TikTok avatar is the only face.
